topics.description: Recent cases of Medicaid fraud have been reported in Minnesota, including charges against 7 individuals and a Fargo woman accused of using professionals' identities in a Medicaid fraud case.
Federal authorities have been actively investigating bribery schemes, including the indictment of Frank Carone, former chief of staff to NYC Mayor Eric Adams, and the arrest of other officials.
topics.reason: Heightened focus on corruption in government
